title: Pressure ulcers: site, stage and healing
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's pressure ulcer, if any.
note:
Chief Complaint: Wound care for sacrum.

HPI: Pt is a 90 y.o. male presenting for f/u of a pressure ulcer located over the sacrum. Pt reports the area is painful but reports no drainage or fever. Pt is currently bedbound due to decreased mobility. Wound was first noted 2 weeks ago. Pt denies any new symptoms since last visit.

Medication List:
- Lisinopril 10mg daily
- Atorvastatin 20mg daily
- Meloxicam 15mg daily

Review of Systems:
Constitutional: No fever, chills, or fatigue.
Integumentary: Pain at sacrum. No rashes elsewhere.
Musculoskeletal: Generalized weakness, decreased mobility.
All other systems reviewed and negative.

Social History: Pt lives at home with a part-time caregiver. Retired. Non-smoker. No alcohol use.

Family History: Father had HTN. Mother had stroke.

Vitals:
BP: 132/78
HR: 74 (RRR)
Temp: 98.6 F
SpO2: 96% on RA
Weight: 165 lbs

Recent Labs:
HbA1c: 6.2%
eGFR: 65
WBC: 8.0 (WNL)

Exam:
General: Alert, oriented x3. Appears in no acute distress.
Skin: Notable stage 2 pressure ulcer over the sacrum. Wound measures approx 2cm x 3cm. Erythema noted at periphery. No purulent drainage. Wound bed is pink and moist. Surrounding skin intact.

Assessment:
1. Stage 2 pressure ulcer of the sacrum.

Plan:
1. Pressure ulcer: Continue current wound care. Cleanse with normal saline. Apply hydrocolloid dressing to the sacrum site. 
2. Education: Discussed importance of frequent repositioning and pressure relief. 
3. F/u: Return to clinic in 2 weeks for wound assessment.

Electronically signed, 
L. Moreau, DO
10/14/2026
explanations: Pressure ulcer of the sacral region, stage 2: L89.152 (HCC 382).

distractors.why: The stage is documented: it decides the code and the HCC.

hccs.label: Pressure Ulcer of Skin with Partial Thickness Skin Loss
